answer: Each identity claims one ridge-side lotus pond, stakes 70 credits, and at dawn files a signed record of pond temperature and frost-line height above. A checker derives the frost line from the lapse-rate table and that dawn temperature; a height off by over 3%, or a pond serial used twice, forfeits the stake. First pond 36 credits, kth 36+7(k-1); the thousandth 7,029, so 1,000 false ponds cost 3,532,500 plus 70,000 staked. A rented-thermometer ring fails since a single pond reading fits only one ridge height. An honest filer pays 36 once and gets the stake back after a clear check.
